They are critically important to the planet as the Earth's lungs, absorbing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and producing oxygen.  These forests are found on every continent, from the Amazon to the boreal forests to the tropical forests of Africa, Asia and North America.  They are home to a wide variety of plant and animal species, thus contributing to global biodiversity.  However, many of the world's forests are threatened by deforestation, climate change and other environmental pressures.  Forest conservation is essential to preserve biological diversity, maintain ecological balance and fight global warming.
